increment_operators.rule: wrong rule: An array loop processes the whole array from index 0 to length-1 and increments its index at the end of the body, whatever the code says. Right rule: The loop visits exactly the indices that its initialisation, guard and update produce, in the order in which its statements are written.

loop_body.quote: The body runs 4 times, for i = 1, 2, 3 and 4; so it runs 4 times; the i++ inside the body does not change how many times the loop runs
loop_body.rule: wrong rule: Values changed by one pass of a loop (other than the loop variable) do not affect later passes. Right rule: Each pass starts from the state left by the previous pass, so a change in one pass carries into the next ones.
